<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/plugins/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Stops the plugin, drops its tables, settings, secrets, grants and files, and removes it. A plugin that ships with Termix keeps its files in the image but is marked uninstalled and never loads again until it is installed from the Plugins tab. Refused while a running plugin depends on it.
